text.tspan: Share of population living in multidimensional poverty in urban vs. rural
Multidimensional poverty is defined as being deprived in a range of health, education and living standards indicators.
Share in multidimensional poverty – Urban areas
Share in multidimensional poverty – Rural areas
Data source: Alkire et al. (2025) - The Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) 2025
Note: Estimates based on the most recent household survey data (between 2013 and 2023). A separate dataset is produced to monitor trends
over time. Where data for 2023 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2013 and 2033 is shown instead.
